title: Mezzan Holding appoints Gaurav Oberoi Deputy CEO – Industrial
summary: He will focus on strengthening operational performance, developing organizational capabilities and driving sustainable growth across the Industrials Division

contentHtml:
Gaurav Oberoi, Deputy CEO – Industrial, Mezzan Holding. Image Courtesy: Mezzan Holding

He will focus on strengthening operational performance, developing organizational capabilities and driving sustainable growth across the Industrials Division

Press Release

Kuwait: Mezzan Holding Co. KSCP, one of the largest manufacturers and distributors of food, beverage, FMCG, and healthcare products in the Gulf region, today announced the appointment of Mr. Gaurav Oberoi as Deputy Chief Executive Officer – Industrial, effective 12 October 2026.

In his new role, Mr. Oberoi will focus on strengthening operational performance, developing organizational capabilities and driving sustainable growth across the Industrials Division. He brings more than 27 years of experience in the FMCG, Food and Industrials divisions, having held several leadership positions within the Group, most notably as General Manager of Kuwait Indo Trading Co. (KITCO). He also serves on the boards of Kuwait Lube Oil Company (KLOC), and Plastic Industries Company, both Mezzan subsidiaries.

The appointment reflects the Board’s confidence in his leadership capabilities and strategic vision to guide the Industrials Division through its next phase of growth and support long-term business development.

Mr. Oberoi is Chairman of the Indian Business and Professional Council (IBPC) in Kuwait. He is a graduate of the Kelley School of Business at Indiana University and of the Singularity University Presidents Program.

About Mezzan Holding:

  • Operates in six countries through 34 subsidiaries with more than 6,700 employees.
  • Distributes over 34,000 Stock Keeping Units (SKU), making it one of the largest operators in terms of SKUs, unit sales, market share, and in terms of share of revenues of total consumer spending in consumer categories served by the company
  • Active in various segments of the consumer staple industry supported by long-standing relationships with Johnson & Johnson, Kimberly-Clark, Reckitt Benckiser, General Mills, Arla Foods, Sara Lee, and many other leading brands and manufacturers
  • Serves over 60,000 meals a day in Kuwait and Qatar through its catering business
  • Has a total of 190,000 square meters in food, beverage, and FMCG manufacturing facilities in Kuwait, Qatar and UAE
  • Leverages long-standing relationships with private and cooperative supermarkets
  • Vertically integrated into complementary business operations, including packaging, catering, contract services, and logistics
  • Food services customers include multinational fast-food chains, airline catering services, and large food services companies

 Mezzan Holding is an 80-year-old company that was listed on the Kuwait Stock Exchange in the second quarter of 2015. The company is headquartered in Kuwait with direct operational activities in Kuwait, UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Iraq and Jordan.
